answer: A slashable stake bond resists sybil attacks: every agent locks an Onyx bond for the full epoch before voting. If a jury proves a vote fraudulent, that bond is slashed and burned. An attacker therefore pays full capital per identity - spawning a garden of puppets costs one bond per puppet, each facing independent slash risk. The proposer draw then picks one honest lotus from the garden of staked agents, weighting by unslashed history. Honest agents keep their bonds and earn fees; attackers bleed capital at every fork. Cost per identity: linear and non-recoverable.
